data.title: UN Report Highlights Saudi Arabia’s Strong Digital Government, Data and AI Ecosystem
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA) has contributed to advancing Saudi Arabia’s digital transformation by developing an integrated national ecosystem comprising 12 projects, initiatives, and platforms in data, artificial intelligence, and digital infrastructure.
    These efforts have improved government service efficiency, strengthened integration among government entities, and developed national capabilities, supporting an advanced digital government powered by innovation and modern technologies, in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
    Saudi Arabia has achieved a new global milestone, ranking first worldwide in the Online Service Index (OSI) and among the top five countries in the UN E-Government Development Index (EGDI) for 2026. It also secured top positions globally in the Telecommunications Infrastructure Index (TII), Participation and Engagement (PE), and E-Government Infrastructure (EGI).
    The UN report highlighted Saudi Arabia’s adoption of a robust institutional framework for digital government, data, and artificial intelligence. This reflects the integration of national efforts and technological enablers that SDAIA contributes to developing to advance digital transformation and improve government services.
    -- SPA
